title: Chapter 460 Da Huang Upgrade
content:
Chapter 460 Da Huang Upgrade

Under a broken wall in a ruin, Wang Shuo took a deep breath for a while, and then confirmed that the place was safe.

Wang Shuo carefully checked Da Huang's condition.

Da Huang was the golden boss at first, and now there are signs of a breakthrough.

This made Wang Shuo very happy.

Bing Feng Huang also reached his limit, and only needed an opportunity to break through to the strongest king.

If Wang Shuo and Bing Feng Huang both broke through to the strongest king, then the Wana Empire would have three strongest kings, which is considered a top force in the borderland.

Wang Shuo no longer hesitated and began to explore slowly, looking for lone ghosts.

He was too careless just now.

Da Huang was very eager for ghosts, and Wang Shuo decided to kill more lonely ghosts.

After a good rest, Wang Shuo continued to explore, and soon he found a group of wandering ghosts again.

Wang Shuo easily killed the ghosts.

In fact, the ghosts in this place cannot be killed by external forces. The defeated ghosts turn into dead air and can quickly reassemble their bodies.

But if they are absorbed by other ghosts, they are really dead.

The ghosts absorbed by Da Huang are the same. They only exhale dead air.

These dead airs soon spread between heaven and earth and can no longer condense their bodies.

Not long after, Da Huang directly upgraded.

This made Wang Shuo more motivated.

Although Wang Shuo summoned the demon king Maris, he rarely let him take action.

Wang Shuo came to this place to train. Without enough combat experience, even with the strength of the king, it is difficult to become a top master.

So, in the following time, Wang Shuo did it himself. There was really a huge gap in strength, so he asked Naris to assist in the attack. If he still couldn't beat him, he could only run away.

Da Huang also successfully became a star-level boss a few days later.

This made Bing Fenghuang and the demon king sigh in their hearts.

Thinking back to the beginning, they wanted to reach this level, and they had gone through untold hardships and wandered on the edge of death many times.

Look at Da Huang again, they are jealous!

Sure enough, it is better to raise it at home!

Wang Shuo has been wandering in this cemetery for 3 days, and he has completed two-thirds of the task.

But it is difficult to encounter a single tombstone nearby.

Wang Shuo observed for a long time and planned to take action against the previous Xuehe Gang.

The reason for choosing them is, of course, for revenge!

After Da Huang was upgraded to Xingyao boss, he turned into the nemesis of ghosts and could directly absorb the souls of ghosts.

This is the confidence of Wang Shuo to dare to retaliate.

"Xuehe Gang, come out and die!"

Wang Shuo shouted from a distance at the tombstone.

"Damn, who dares to come to our Xuehe Gang's territory to make trouble?"

The ghosts of the Xuehe Gang crawled out of the cemetery one after another.

Seeing that it was Wang Shuo and others, they burst into laughter.

"You defeated generals, dare you to act wild again? I let you escape last time, but you won't be so lucky this time."

Wang Shuo saw that the opponent's boss had not yet appeared, and did not let the Demon King take action.

He rushed straight over with Da Huang and Bing Feng Huang.

Bing Feng Huang used a freezing skill directly, and the ghost in the front was directly frozen into an ice sculpture.

And the ghosts behind were also slowed down.

Wang Shuo directly used "Directly Attacking Huanglong" to hit it seriously. Da Huang's three dog heads exerted force and sucked it fiercely. The opponent turned into ghost mist and sucked it into Da Huang's mouth, and then sprayed it out of his nose and dissipated between heaven and earth.
